_doc: The symbol of each cuisine (graph_metadata.json) in the recipe galaxy: a dish or two things the kitchen is known for, drawn with the ingredient symbol prompt (services/ingredient_symbols.concept_symbol) and kept in concept_visual (concept_type cuisine). Not flags: Nordic, Middle Eastern and Eastern European are regions, and a dish says more than a country. Made with scripts/category_symbols.py --kind cuisine.
form: Show it as served, small and simple, with nothing under or around it: no plate, board, cutlery or garnish beyond what is named. No circle, frame, border or badge: it stands free on the white background.

looks.Nordic: three brown Norwegian meatballs in brown gravy with a spoonful of red lingonberries beside them
looks.Italian: a small twirl of spaghetti in red tomato sauce with one green basil leaf
looks.Mexican: two folded soft tacos filled with minced meat, lettuce and salsa
looks.American: a cheeseburger with lettuce, tomato and melted cheese in a sesame bun
looks.Indian: a piece of naan bread beside a small heap of orange butter chicken curry
looks.Thai: a small heap of pad thai noodles with shrimp, crushed peanuts and a lime wedge
looks.Middle Eastern: three falafel balls on a round pita bread with a spoonful of hummus
looks.Japanese: two pieces of salmon nigiri sushi and one maki roll
looks.French: a golden croissant beside a wedge of brie
looks.Greek: a wedge of white feta with three black olives and a slice of cucumber
looks.Korean: a small heap of red napa cabbage kimchi
looks.Eastern European: three half-moon pierogi dumplings with a spoonful of sour cream
looks.Other: a lemon, a garlic bulb and a sprig of fresh herbs
